units.source_text: 不一会儿便走到了村子的尽头，那里已经没有民房了，只有一片稀疏的小松林。

en.t: Before long, he had walked to the edge of the village, where there were no houses anymore, only a sparse grove of small pines.

units.source_text: 不知不觉，地面也变成了沙地，肌理细密，仿佛要将脚掌都吸进去似的。

en.t: Without his noticing, the ground too had turned to sand, fine-grained as if it might suck in the soles of his feet.

units.source_text: 随处可见干草垛，在沙窝里形成黑影；

en.t: Stacks of dried grass could be seen everywhere, casting dark shadows in the hollows of the sand;

units.source_text: 除此之外，像放错位置似的，还有一张榻榻米那么大的贫瘠的田地，种着几株茄子。

en.t: Apart from that, as if set down in the wrong place, there was also a barren patch of field about the size of one tatami mat, planted with a few eggplants.
There was not a single person to be seen here.

units.source_text: 前面总算就是想要去的海滩了。

en.t: Ahead at last was the beach he had been trying to reach.
